asi.lesson: Anti-tautology verification (temporarily inject bug, confirm test fails) is essential. A test that cannot fail is theater, not testing. Two of our '8/8 green' structural tests were tautologies — they passed regardless of whether the code was correct. Always verify tests can fail.
